description: Search PUBLIC Threads posts for a keyword or topic — competitor listening, finding what people say about a product, or sourcing real customer language for ad copy.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

authorUsername.description: only posts by this Threads account (exact username, no @) — 'what has @competitor said about X'

mediaType.description: TEXT, IMAGE or VIDEO — only that kind of post

searchMode.description: KEYWORD (default) or TAG — TAG searches a TOPIC TAG (what is being said under #skincare)

since.description: only posts on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO or unix seconds; Threads search reaches back to 2023-07-05)

name: search_threads_keyword
title: Search Threads by keyword
